en.headline: Moonshot AI files confidentially for Hong Kong IPO
en.dek: The Beijing developer of the Kimi large language model has submitted a confidential listing application and is said to be targeting about US$3 billion in proceeds.
body: Beijing-based artificial-intelligence start-up Moonshot has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter. The company, known for its Kimi large language model, is aiming to raise roughly US$3 billion, one source said.

Moonshot’s latest model, Kimi K3, released in July, has drawn positive reviews and strong demand. The firm was valued at about US$50 billion in an ongoing private funding round, according to separate sources. It has been in talks with major US cloud providers about possible revenue-sharing arrangements that would allow them to host the model.

A Hong Kong listing would mark one of the more closely watched Chinese AI debuts in the near term. Moonshot has been restructuring its corporate setup to meet regulatory requirements for an overseas listing. The company declined to comment on the market reports.

zh.headline: 月之暗面Moonshot秘密遞表申請香港上市
zh.dek: 開發Kimi大語言模型的北京初創據報已向港交所提交保密申請，目標集資約30億美元。
body: 據知情人士透露，北京人工智能初創公司月之暗面（Moonshot）已秘密向香港交易所遞交上市申請。該公司以Kimi大語言模型聞名，其中一名消息人士指集資目標約30億美元。
Moonshot於7月發布的最新模型Kimi K3獲得正面評價及強勁需求。另有消息指，公司在進行中的私募融資輪估值約500億美元。公司亦據報正與美國大型雲服務商洽談收益分成安排，以便對方托管其模型。
若成功在港上市，將成為近期備受關注的中國人工智能企業公開募股之一。Moonshot一直調整企業架構以符合境外上市監管要求。公司對市場報道不予置評。
